messages:
marina (partnerships): FYI had a quick sync with EdgeFleet earlier. they proposed a new 'flex-slot' reserved SKU that mixes reserved + opportunistic capacity. wondering if we can model this into cost forecasts.
michelle (edgefleet): thanks @marina! quick summary: flex-slot = commit to monthly slot-hours at a discount, with a 20% burstable pool priced at spot rates. billing is monthly in arrears, 30–45 day invoice lag. we can provide weekly availability curves.
alex (finance): 30–45 day lag is annoying for cashflow. what's the invoicing granularity? per-slot or aggregated SKU-level?
michelle (edgefleet): per-SKU aggregated. details: base commit hours, burst consumed separately, overage billed at spot with a small premium if >50% burst use. we can emit CSV for daily usage forecasts.
sophie (product): important to know fallback semantics — if burst unavailable, do you have preflights to redirect to other partners? affects our routing policy and SLOs.
michelle (edgefleet): yes, can set a soft cap and a hard cap. soft cap returns 429s; hard cap returns empty capacity. we recommend a 10–15% reservation buffer for latency-sensitive routes.
raj (eng): can you share expected p95 latency delta under burst vs reserved? we need for modelled performance cost.
michelle (edgefleet): typical p95 increase 30–60ms on burst nodes; reserved nodes stable. will include histograms.
tom (sales): if we accept this SKU, marketplace listing fee? and are they open to a pilot with a smaller commit term (60 days) to start?
michelle (edgefleet): marketplace listing fee is standard 1.5% + variable placement fee. pilot ok, 60–90 day pilot window.
alex (finance): for cost model inputs we need: unit price reserved (USD/hr), unit price burst (USD/hr), expected burst utilization curve (daily), invoice lag days, minimum commit term, overage premium, and any volume tiers. can you deliver by EOD Friday?
michelle (edgefleet): yes, pushing CSV and JSON schema by Friday. sample CSV preview attached below.
billing-bot: uploaded file: edgefleet_flex_sample.csv (preview)
marina (partnerships): putting the ask here for clarity so modelling team can start — please annotate whether numbers are guaranteed or estimates.
alex (finance): also need cashflow mapping: when we invoice vs when we pay providers. EdgeFleet paying vendors? or we pay them?
michelle (edgefleet): EdgeFleet handles vendor consolidation; we invoice Redwood, we pay infra vendors.
jen (legal): we need to review the pilot T&Cs for SLA credits and data residency notes. share template.
sophie (product): from a UX standpoint we should expose 'flex-slot' as a distinct routing policy option: low-latency (reserved-prefer) vs cost (flex-prefer) and a hybrid. Raj, can the routing layer support soft caps + automatic fallback?
raj (eng): yes, routing can match a policy to a SKU tag. need the soft cap numeric and an eta for how quickly EdgeFleet updates availability metadata (heartbeat interval).
michelle (edgefleet): will publish availability metadata every 5m and provide a 24h historical heatmap.
tom (sales): curious on margins — if burst price spikes, do we have an automatic pass-through so customer pricing stays predictable?
alex (finance): modelers please include a 'worst-case spot spike' scenario (+3x spot for 48h) and 'sustained burst' scenario (60% of monthly commit).
marina (partnerships): michelle, can you also include minimum notice for capacity changes or eviction windows?
michelle (edgefleet): 72h notice for planned maintenance that affects >20% capacity; immediate for preemptions (we'll send webhooks).
raj (eng): webhook format pls — short example would help.
michelle (edgefleet): example webhook payload:
```
{
  "sku": "edgefleet-flex-1",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-01T12:00:00Z",
  "available_slots": 120,
  "eviction_expected": false
}
```
marina (partnerships): ok next steps: EdgeFleet to deliver CSV + JSON schema + latency histograms by Friday. finance to draft cashflow integration notes. legal to sync on pilot T&Cs. eng to validate routing + webhook parsing. I'll schedule a follow-up Monday. :calendar: :thumbsup:
alex (finance): ack, will prepare a template for the cashflow model with fields for invoice lag and payment timing.
sophie (product): I'll draft the product acceptance criteria for the pilot.
raj (eng): will spike a small parser for the webhook and test with sample payload.
michelle (edgefleet): thanks all — pushing materials to the shared drive now: https://redwood.cloud/partnerships/edgefleet/materials
tom (sales): happy to run a quick pilot proposal with enterprise beta customers once legal clears.
marina (partnerships): great, closing this thread for now. follow-up meeting invite sent. :email:
